subject: Retain moving falling-arrow endpoints through Refresh
description: RHElementArrow::Refresh tests the projectile's literal 3D old/current positions before retiring an empty falling trajectory. Rust instead tested separately serialized sprite-position caches, which can already be equal while the endpoint's 3D movement snapshot is still live, and retired the arrow before its following Projectile::Hourglass could stop flight and apply the ordinary ground snap. Live falling endpoints now use the 3D PositionInterface movement predicate; the obsolete raw sprite-cache predicate was removed.
